statements.statement: The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
Diagnosis codes I48.0 and I47.1 were submitted
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to accurately characterize the frequency and duration of arrhythmic events
The required prior authorization was missing
